remarks: Discover this newly renovated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bath townhouse rental in the highly sought-after Springdale section of the city. The unit features a beautifully updated kitchen. Stainless steel appliances, beautiful granite counter tops, new cabinets and newly installed hardwood floors throughout. Spacious living/dining room combo. One of the two full baths has been completely renovated to add a modern touch. This unit offers both convenience and style. Close to public transportation, metro north railroad, and shopping centers. 2 assigned parking spots. No pets allowed. Tenant pays electric (heat & hot water) & liability insurance. Remove your shoes or use provided shoe covers at entrance. It's available immediately!
